name: ih_usage_trace
description: Records Claude usage (session and week percent) every 5 minutes and labelled events (who or what used it), shows both on one chart and flags unattributed jumps. Own database, token-protected API, page.
restore: Stop the add-on. The series and events live in the add-on's own database (/data/ih.db, daily snapshots in /data/backup) and are lost on uninstall; they are only a convenience record.
